text:
Maya: trying to onboard a HF model that uses a custom config class (trust_remote_code). conversion tool choked on auto_map import and tokenizer special tokens seem remapped.
Maya: run output:
```
ERROR: auto_map import error: module 'hf_repo.modeling' has no attribute 'CustomChatModel'
tokenizer special_tokens_map: {"additional_special_tokens": ["<|usr|>", "<|sys|>"]}
convert-bot: conversion attempt failed, falling back to safe-json.
```
Maya: model works locally with `transformers` when using `trust_remote_code=True` but Redwood convert isn't preserving the chat template or the special tokens.
Omar: can you paste the model's config.json and tokenizer.json snippet? check for `special_tokens_map` and `input_format` keys.
Maya: here's the minimal config snippet:
```
{"architectures": ["CustomChatModel"],
 "model_type": "custom_chat",
 "chat_format": "<|sys|>{system}\n<|usr|>{user}\n<|assistant|>"}
```
Maya: tokenizer.json has `additional_special_tokens` as above. convert tool output shows tokens remapped to ids that overlap with eos.
Liam: auto_map issues are usually because the repo uses `from .modeling import CustomChatModel` and conversion runs in isolated env. convert-bot can't import arbitrary code without trust flag.
Sara: quick workaround: add a small shim that defines a dummy `CustomChatModel` that subclasses `PreTrainedModel` and register it in `auto_map` before conversion. Or add `--trust-remote-code` flag to the convert step (if allowed).
Maya: tried `--trust-remote-code` and conversion proceeded but the chat template ended up in `model_card` instead of `config.chat_format`. evals show a regression: conversational turn-level metrics dropped ~7% on our rubric after quantization.
Omar: can you share the eval summary lines? even single-line numbers help triage.
Maya: eval snippet:
```
baseline_fp32: conv_score=0.78
converted_q4_0: conv_score=0.72
delta: -0.06
notes: hallucination ↑ in system prompts with emojis and special tokens
```
Liam: emoji and special token handling can change tokenizer offsets after quant/merge which affects attention alignment. Try preserving exact token ids by providing `tokenizer_config.json` with `special_tokens_map` and `added_tokens` list.
Sara: also confirm `pad_token_id`/`eos_token_id` weren't silently remapped. We had one case where `<|sys|>` got id 50256 (eos) because of token-merging during conversion.
Maya: good catch — padded tokens were wrong. Manual patch fixed token ids and conv_score moved to 0.75 after re-eval. still ~0.03 gap.
Omar: for auto_map import failures, long-term we should support an `import_hook` that runs repo-level code in a sandboxed environment for class discovery. I'll open a GH issue and link a test case.
Maya: thanks — for now I'll keep the shim approach and add a canary rollout in Dedicated to compare latency + quality. Will also add the tokenizer fix to onboarding checklist.
convert-bot: created onboarding ticket REDWOOD-ML-3421 for `trust_remote_code` onboarding flow and tokenizer special token preservation.
Maya: awesome, leaving notes in the model card. :thumbsup:
